simple.meaning: מַגֵּפָה (maggêphâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a pestilence ; by analogy, defeat.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 26 times across Exodus, Numbers, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, and 4 more, beginning at Exodus 9:14. Its contexts include family, family line, death, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַגֵּפָה (H4046).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
